financials_interim.notes: Company (standalone, non-consolidated parent-only) column of the same filing -- Lankem Developments PLC is a pure holding company at the standalone level with no revenue/cost of sales/gross profit lines (all shown as '-' in the filing, so those fields are left blank here rather than set to 0). operating_profit = Administration Expenses only (-2,336, a loss, since there is no revenue or other income at Company level); PBT = -2,336 + Net Finance Cost of +7 (net finance INCOME this quarter, vs a net finance cost of 899 in the prior-year quarter) = -2,329, ties to disclosed Loss before Tax exactly. EPS (Rs.-0.01) = -2,355,000/160,000,000 = -0.0147, rounds to the disclosed -0.01. No interest-bearing borrowings, inventory, or trade receivables are disclosed at Company level (all '-'), left blank rather than 0.

Lankem Developments PLC (LDEV) is a plantations holding group (principal subsidiary: Agarapatana Plantations PLC, 'Plantations' segment) plus a small 'Others' segment; figures are in Rs.'000 as presented in the filing. operating_profit (107,856) is DERIVED from the primary P&L (Gross Profit 212,857 + Other Income 15,303 - Distribution Cost 30,000 - Administration Expenses 90,304 = 107,856), which ties exactly to disclosed PBT after deducting Net Finance Cost of 767 (107,856-767=107,089=disclosed PBT), and is used IN PREFERENCE to the Segmental note's own 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' total of 111,485 for this same quarter, which does NOT reconcile (111,485-767=110,718, not 107,089 -- an unreconciled gap of 3,629, implying an undisclosed unallocated/corporate cost not shown as a separate line in the segment table). The prior-year (30.06.2025) segmental operating-profit total of 116,866 DOES tie exactly to that period's PBT+finance cost (109,263+7,603=116,866), so the discrepancy is specific to the current-quarter segment table, not a systemic definitional difference -- flagged here per this project's cross-check discipline rather than silently picking one figure. finance_costs is the filing's single 'Net Finance Cost' line (767); finance_income is not separately disclosed so is left at 0. Balance sheet identity (9,825,696 = 6,346,395+3,479,301) and EPS (=37,223/160,000,000=0.23, attributable-profit basis) both tie exactly. short_term_borrowings = current 'Interest Bearing Borrowings' (717,061) + Bank Overdraft (495,952); long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Interest Bearing Borrowings' (236,310); IFRS16 lease liabilities (116 non-current + 3 current, immaterial) are excluded from borrowings per the same convention used for ASIY and LOFC in this session. capex = Acquisition of PP&E (32,567) + Investment in Consumable Biological Assets (756) + Investment in Field Development (2,601) = 35,924 -- for a plantation group these biological-asset/field-development cash outflows are capital investment in the crop base, not operating costs, so are included alongside PP&E in the capex figure.

interim_updates.note_text: Lankem Developments PLC (LDEV), the Colombo-listed plantations holding group (principal subsidiary Agarapatana Plantations PLC, reported as the 'Plantations' segment, plus a small 'Others' segment), reported Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026) Group revenue of Rs.1,751.3m, down 15.3% YoY from Rs.2,068.6m, almost entirely driven by the Plantations segment (Rs.1,736.8m vs Rs.2,046.9m, -15.2%, which is ~99% of group revenue) -- consistent with softer tea/rubber prices or crop volumes at Agarapatana. Despite the revenue decline, gross margin actually IMPROVED to 12.2% from 10.5% as cost of sales fell 16.9% (Rs.1,538.4m vs Rs.1,851.4m), a slightly faster pace than revenue, and PBT was nearly flat at Rs.107.1m (-2.0% YoY from Rs.109.3m) -- operating profit fell a modest 7.7% to Rs.107.9m from Rs.116.9m, but that was largely offset by Net Finance Cost collapsing 89.9% to Rs.0.8m from Rs.7.6m (debt was reduced: Rs.522.0m of long-term loans were repaid against Rs.419.1m of new proceeds this quarter, and total interest-bearing borrowings fell to Rs.953.4m from a higher year-ago base). However, PAT fell sharply -- down 36.7% YoY to Rs.66.1m from Rs.104.4m -- because tax expense surged 740% to Rs.41.0m from Rs.4.9m. The segmental note shows this tax increase is concentrated entirely in the Plantations segment, which paid essentially NO tax in Q1 FY2025/26 but Rs.37.2m this quarter (the 'Others' segment's tax fell, from Rs.4.9m to Rs.3.8m) -- i.e. despite near-flat pre-tax profitability, the plantation subsidiary's effective tax rate rose sharply, likely reflecting exhaustion of prior tax-loss carryforwards or a change in tax concessions, and this alone explains almost all of the 36.7% PAT decline. At the standalone Company (parent-only) level, the entity remained loss-making, with a Rs.2.4m loss for the quarter versus a Rs.4.9m loss a year ago -- narrower, but still negative, since the parent itself has no revenue and exists only to hold subsidiary investments and incur administration costs.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for LDEV -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. YoY comparison uses only this filing's own 30 June 2025 comparative column (both P&L, Statement of Financial Position via the Statement of Changes in Equity's 'Balance as at 30 June 2025' row, and the Segmental note provide genuine comparatives). The Segmental note's current-quarter 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' total (111,485) does not reconcile to disclosed PBT and was NOT used for operating_profit -- see the 'notes' field on the GROUP financial_statements row for the full reconciliation.
interim_updates.takeaway: The 36.7% YoY fall in Group PAT (to Rs.66.1m from Rs.104.4m) looks like an operating deterioration but is almost entirely a TAX story, not an operating one: PBT was nearly flat (-2.0%) and operating profit before finance costs fell only modestly, while tax expense surged 740% (Rs.4.9m to Rs.41.0m), concentrated in the Plantations segment which paid essentially no tax a year ago -- investors should look through the PAT decline to the roughly-stable pre-tax operating performance underneath it.
operational_highlights: Group revenue -15.3% YoY to Rs.1,751.3m, driven almost entirely by the Plantations segment (Rs.1,736.8m, -15.2%, ~99% of group revenue)
Gross margin improved to 12.2% from 10.5% as cost of sales fell 16.9% (Rs.1,538.4m vs Rs.1,851.4m), a faster pace than the revenue decline

PBT nearly flat at Rs.107.1m (-2.0% YoY) but PAT fell 36.7% to Rs.66.1m as tax expense surged 740% to Rs.41.0m from Rs.4.9m, concentrated in the Plantations segment (nil tax a year ago vs Rs.37.2m this quarter)
Net Finance Cost fell 89.9% YoY to Rs.0.8m from Rs.7.6m following net debt reduction (Rs.522.0m of long-term loans repaid vs Rs.419.1m of new proceeds this quarter)
Group net cash used in operating activities was Rs.106.8m (vs Rs.101.9m used a year ago), mainly reflecting a Rs.519.7m build-up in Inventories

Net Assets per Share fell to Rs.14.68 from Rs.19.27 at 31 March 2026, though this reflects the Group's Reserve for FVOCI Financial Assets remaining negative (Rs.-102.4m) rather than a change in share count (160,000,000 shares unchanged)
key_drivers: Plantations segment tax expense: nil in Q1 FY2025/26 to Rs.37.2m this quarter -- the single largest driver of the 36.7% YoY PAT decline, despite the segment's PBT being roughly flat (Rs.101.3m vs Rs.100.8m)
Plantations segment revenue -15.2% YoY (Rs.2,046.9m to Rs.1,736.8m) -- almost the entire group revenue decline, consistent with softer tea/rubber prices or crop volumes
Net Finance Cost -89.9% YoY (Rs.7.6m to Rs.0.8m) on debt reduction -- partially offset the softer segment operating profit and kept PBT nearly flat
